source: real browser against FastAPI and disposable PostgreSQL; worker pipeline is deterministic fake
assertions: registered a real account and received an authenticated session
file selection uses a visible 44px+ label target and the native input has a keyboard-visible focus indicator
upload stayed awaiting_confirmation without worker activity; confirmation persisted the user-edited title and queued work
reduced-motion replaced the animated waiting asset with its static image during a live build
taste inspector reviewed an authenticated live RUNNING page snapshot at 1280, 768, and 390px (design-only)
real BuildWorker persisted reading and running checkpoints across reload, then completed the manifest-backed build
a second upload of identical bytes reused the succeeded build while keeping a distinct course and title context
course list displayed both titles and resumed the second course through its own course ID
cancellation during a paused reading step stopped the real worker at its next boundary and persisted cancelled
